name: Duchy of Lower Bavaria (House of Wittelsbach)

predecessors.name: Stem Duchy of Bavaria
predecessors.text: Lower Bavaria, Henry XIII's share in the partition of 1255: 'Henry received Lower Bavaria and Louis Upper Bavaria and the Palatinate' (Henry XIII page)

successors.name: Duchy of Bavaria
successors.text: Lower Bavaria, inherited by Emperor Louis IV on the death of Duke John I in 1340, who reunited the duchy

rulers.name: Otto III (jointly with Louis III to 1296 and Stephen I to 1310)
Henry XIV the Elder (jointly with Otto IV, d. 1334)

ledger.x: 1255: the Wittelsbach brothers divide Bavaria and Henry XIII takes Lower Bavaria.
1340: Lower Bavaria passes to Emperor Louis IV.
1340: the Lower Bavarian line dies out and the duchy is reunited.

wars.name: Ottokar II's invasion of Bavaria (1257)
wars.outcome: Repulsed: 'In August 1257, Ottokar invaded Bavaria, but Henry and Louis managed to repulse the attack.'

certainty.note: No page opened gives a boundary of Lower Bavaria; the outline is Cliopatria's approximation of the duchy's lands from Landshut and Burghausen.
